# netactuate_dns_zone (Resource)

Manages a DNS Zone.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netactuate_dns_zone" "example" {
  name = "example"
  type = "NATIVE"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) DNS zone name
- `type` (String) DNS zone type

### Optional

- `ip` (String) Master IP address for SLAVE zones

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `nameservers` (List of String) The nameservers authoritative for this zone
- `soa_hostmaster` (String) The hostmaster address from the zone's SOA record
- `soa_primary` (String) The primary nameserver from the zone's SOA record
- `soa_serial` (String) The serial from the zone's SOA record
- `ttl` (String) The zone's default TTL, returned by the API as a string

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import netactuate_dns_zone.example 12345
```
